names.note: Read out of saint.gr's line for 3 Μαρτίου, «Όσιοι Ζήνων και Ζωίλος», with the rank word left off.

Read out of the title on the name link behind the line for 3 марта ст. ст., name page 845, «Зоил», with the rank words left off. The day’s own line declines the name. The calendar gives him no toponymic, no surname and no epithet on either the line or the link, so the stored form is the bare forename. `.tmp/foldchk.py` reports no folder holding it.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 3 марта ст. ст. — «Св. Зинона и Зоила .»

attestations.note: Not checked: doxologia.ro's calendar for the same civil day (30 September 2026).

source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 3ης Μαρτίου — «Όσιοι Ζήνων και Ζωίλος»

attestations.note: One page holds the two of them and its whole notice is one sentence: «Είναι άγνωστο που και πότε τέλεσαν τον δρόμο της ασκήσεως οι Όσιοι Ζήνων και Ζωίλος, οι οποίοι κοιμήθηκαν με ειρήνη». Because the site says plainly that it has no place and no time, there is no `dates` object here. The page prints an etymology block over the name Ζήνων and none over his, names no relic and gives no hymn. No other bearer of this name stands anywhere in the corpus.
Not checked: the Ohrid Prologue at pravoslavno.rs for the corresponding menologion day (30 September 2026).
